source_text: Timor Dei etiam in Geraris tandem. Foedus cum Abimelech. Haec Homiliae V finis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Fear of-God even in Gerar at-last. Covenant with Abimelech. These of-Homily V end. Amen.
pass_b_english: Fear of God at last even in Gerar. Covenant with Abimelech. This is Homily V’s end. Amen.
